catch_copy: The cute and sexy zombie hunter Juliet goes wild on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
description:
With over 1.5 million copies sold worldwide, the legendary zombie-hunting action game LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW is back at last in a remastered edition!

Using the nimble moves she picked up through cheerleading and wielding a massive chainsaw, Juliet tears through hordes of zombies in fast-paced, over-the-top action.
The Chain Hit Hunting system boosts chainsaw attack speed as your combo builds, while the newly added Chainsaw Blaster with auto-fire cranks the excitement up even further.
With improved playability, flashy visual effects, and brand-new background music, there’s plenty to get stuck into.

Enhanced graphics, a new difficulty mode, and a range of other improvements take things to the next level. This isn’t just a nostalgic throwback—it’s a fully revamped and reborn Lollipop Chainsaw.
Introducing LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP!

＜Story＞
Juliet attends the massive San Romero High School in the American West. She’s an ordinary high school girl who loves cheerleading more than anything.

Right now, she’s got two worries.
First, she’s put on a bit of weight thanks to her favourite lollies.
Second, she’s trying to work out how to tell her new boyfriend Nick that she’s actually a zombie hunter.

And that’s a tricky one… because zombie hunters send the undead off to heaven for a living. Not exactly something you casually bring up!

One morning, as Juliet rushes along on her bike—already running late to meet Nick—a horde of zombies suddenly appears in front of her.
As luck would have it, it’s also her 18th birthday. With her big day ruined, Juliet grabs a chainsaw from her bag and charges into the school, now overrun with zombies, to find her beloved Nick!
formal_name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition
upgrade_description:
Screen resolution has been increased and graphical quality improved.
A Gun Shooting Mode has been added.
Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls can be used in Gun Shooting Mode.
